buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.

3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address THIS SERVICE IS REQUIRED AT DRM OFFICE CAMPUS JAIPUR . 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (i) As per Service GCC 2018, para 2.6.1 Minimum Eligibility Criteria for Work experience are required: Work Experience: - The bidder should have satisfactorily Completed* in the last three previous financial years an d the current financial year upto the date of opening of the tender, one similar single service contract for a minimum of 35 % of advertised value of the bid. * Completed service contract: - Include on-going service c ontract subject to payment of bills amounting to at least 35% of the advertised value of the bid. Instead of The Bidder must have successfully executed / completed at least one single order of 80 % of the Estimated Bid Value or 2 orders each of 50 % of the Estimated Bid Value or 3 orders each of 40 % of the Estimated Bi d Value (ii) Financial Standing: The Bidders will be qualified only if they have minimum financial capabilities as below – T1- Financial Turnover: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 times the advertised Bid value during the last three previous financial years and in the current financial year upto th e date of opening of the tender. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by charter ed accountant with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be considered. T2-Liquidity: The bidder should have access to or has available liquid assets, lines of credit and other finan cial means to meet cash flow that is valued at 5% of the estimated bid value net of applicant’s commitmen ts for other contracts. The audited balance sheet and/or banking reference certified by chartered accounta nt with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be submitted by the bidder along with bid. (iii) Payment will be made on monthly basis, after verifying slips received from all branches of DRM office, J aipur. The received slips must be mentioned entered every day in register. (iv) Railway will provide only Electricity and Place for operations of machines (however Photocopy machine will be provided by seller (v) Timing of working hours from 09:00 AM to 06:30 PM on all working days . (vi) Average number of spiral binding per month is 15 No. & 360 No. in two years. (vi) As per the latest General Conditions of Contract for Services of Indian Railway will be applicable (vii) Any defaulter/suspended firm in previous six month from date of publish of bid from this office also wil l be considered disqualified during technical evaluation (viii) During representation only bid documents/quoted terms & conditions clarification will be accepted. N o any documents will be accepted during representation after opening of technical bid. (ix) General Conditions of Contract for Services of Indian Railway will be applicable. (x) Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 6 months beyond the initial contract duration ( subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent).

(xi) Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only (xii)While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the scr eenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. (xiii)The Bidder must carefully read General and Special Terms and Conditions uploaded by the Buyer in th e Bid-Specific ATC at Serial Number 6 . The bidder must submit acceptance of these General and Special T erms and Conditions duly signed/seal & signed. If firm does not submit this document, offer of the bidder w ill be liable to be rejected. (xiv). The tenderers shall submit a copy of certificate stating that all their statements/ documents submitte d along with bid are true and factual. Standard format of certificate to be submitted by the bidder is enclos ed as Annexure-I. Non- submission of above certificate by the bidder shall result in summary rejection of hi s / their bid. It shall be mandatorily incumbent upon the tenderer to identify, state and submit the supporti ng documents duly self-attested/ digitally signed by which they/ he is qualifying the Qualifying Criteria me ntioned in the Tender Document. It will not be obligatory on the part of Tender Committee/ Accepting Auth ority to scrutinize beyond the submitted document of tenderer as far as his qualification for the tender is co ncerned. Partly / wrongly filled annexure will not be considered. Submission of this annexure (duly filled, s ealed and signed) is mandatory, failing which offer will be summarily rejected. Annexure-I format is attach ed in buyer added bid specific ATC document with special term & conditions at Serial Number 6 . . 6.
